scripts.prebuild: npx --yes ara3d@0.9.0 export --params ../../character-configs/player.json --formats glb --animations idle,walk,run --detail medium --out /tmp/akwantuo-player && mkdir -p public/assets/characters/generated && PLAYER_FILE="$(find /tmp/akwantuo-player -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.glb' -print -quit)" && test -n "$PLAYER_FILE" && cp "$PLAYER_FILE" public/assets/characters/generated/player.glb
